activity.notes: Mubarak bin Sabah Al-Sabah, also called Mubarak the Great, was the seventh ruler of Kuwait from May 1896 until his death on 28 November 1915. The Ministry of State for National Assembly Affairs lists 18 May 1896; alternative chronologies give 17 May, so the reviewed start is intentionally month-precision. The 1899 British agreement and 1914 change of external status did not create a new local dynastic political identity; reuse the existing Kuwait polity. Birth year is disputed and is not asserted as an exact date.
